caption: Mount Rigi, Vitznau
composition: Vitznau shore looking north at the forested ridge of Mount Rigi · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the Vitznau shore, Mount Rigi rises directly behind the village as a broad, forested ridge. Lake Lucerne is the foreground, and the cog-railway line is only a thin trace on the slope. No boat with a readable name is featured. Pastures are still green in late September. The Open-Meteo model is overcast, with soft light and no rain.
